title: ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation
title_zh: ViMoLa：面向语言引导视频生成的离散运动令牌

paragraphs.en: Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 64 tokens from a 512 512 -entry codebook; a 28 28 M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan 2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462 462 K videos from Something-Something v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 0.287 to 0.442 0.442 (chance 0.250 0.250 ), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283 0.283 , supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 0.428 at 1.45 % 1.45\% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 0.301 to 0.398 0.398 . Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531 0.531 , compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments. Code is available at github.com/ostadabbas/ViMoLa .
paragraphs.zh: 语言引导的视频生成往往能够捕捉场景内容，却遗漏了所请求的运动。 我们提出 ViMoLa（Video Motion Language，视频运动语言），它从语言预测运动先验，并将其注入一个冻结的图像到视频骨干网络中。 一个空间向量量化自编码器将稠密轨迹压缩为 64 64 个 token，码本大小为 512 512 条目；一个 28 28 百万参数的 transformer 从文本预测这些 token；零门控交叉注意力适配器通过前向钩子对每个冻结的 Wan 2.2 DiT 块施加条件。 在来自 Something-Something v2 和 Kinetics-400 的 462 462 千个视频上训练后，ViMoLa 将方向准确率从 0.287 0.287 提升到 0.442 0.442（随机水平为 0.250 0.250），同时测量到的生成质量相近。 跨提示打乱编码仅达到 0.283 0.283，这支持了与提示匹配的 token 内容的重要性。 一个低秩适配器在仅增加 1.45 % 1.45\% 前向传播 FLOPs 的情况下达到 0.428 0.428；并且通过复用分词器和语言模型、仅为 CogVideoX 训练新的适配器，准确率从 0.301 0.301 提升到 0.398 0.398。 可控性仍不完善：oracle 编码达到 0.531 0.531，复合运动的增益较小，且该适配器并未显式保留 token 到图像块的对应关系。 代码可在 github.com/ostadabbas/ViMoLa 获取。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video generation has advanced rapidly, with large diffusion transformers (DiTs) such as Wan 2.2 [ 25 , 22 ] , CogVideoX [ 30 ] , and Stable Video Diffusion [ 1 ] producing clips that are sharp, temporally coherent, and rich in motion. These models are exceptionally good at deciding what a video contains: prompt them for “a hand sliding a cup across a table” and a hand and a cup reliably appear. They are far less controllable about how the content moves. The same prompt may send the cup left, right, or barely at all; the trajectory, speed, and timing of the motion are an emergent property of sampling rather than something the user can specify ( Fig. 1 ). For applications that care about motion (e.g., robotics demonstrations, instructional content, animation, data augmentation for action recognition) this gap between semantic and kinematic control is a fundamental limitation.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频生成发展迅速，像 Wan 2.2 [ 25 , 22 ] 、CogVideoX [ 30 ] 和 Stable Video Diffusion [ 1 ] 这样的大型扩散Transformer（DiT）能够生成清晰、时间上连贯且动作丰富的视频片段。 这些模型在决定视频内容方面极为出色：让它们生成“一只手将杯子滑过桌面”，一只手和一个杯子就会可靠地出现。 但它们对内容如何运动的控制能力要弱得多。 同样的提示词可能让杯子向左、向右移动，或者几乎不动；运动的轨迹、速度和时机是采样过程中涌现的属性，而不是用户能够指定的东西（图 1 ）。 对于关心运动的应用（例如机器人演示、教学内容、动画、动作识别的数据增强）而言，语义控制与运动控制之间的这种差距是一个根本性的局限。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work restores motion control by conditioning generation on an explicit motion signal: trajectories, drags, or dense flow fields fed directly into the denoiser [ 27 , 28 , 32 , 34 , 6 ] . These methods are powerful, but they share two properties that limit their reach. First, the user must supply that motion at inference time. Dense motion is exactly the kind of high-dimensional, hard-to-author signal most users do not have, which is why language became the dominant interface for generation in the first place. Second, control is typically wired into the base generator, either by adding trainable branches to its layers or by fine-tuning it, which ties the controller to a specific backbone and risks eroding the generative prior that makes the backbone valuable.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的工作通过以显式运动信号为条件来控制生成，从而恢复运动控制：将轨迹、拖拽或稠密光流场直接输入去噪器 [ 27 , 28 , 32 , 34 , 6 ] 。 这些方法功能强大，但它们共有两个限制其适用范围的特性。 首先，用户必须在推理时提供该运动信号。 稠密运动恰恰是那种高维、难以构造、大多数用户并不具备的信号，这也正是语言最初成为生成的主流交互方式的原因。 其次，控制通常被硬编码接入基础生成器，要么通过在其网络层中添加可训练分支，要么通过对其进行微调，这将控制器与特定的骨干网络绑定在一起，并可能侵蚀使骨干网络具有价值的生成先验。

paragraphs.en: We learn a compact motion vocabulary that bridges language and a frozen image-to-video generator. Neighboring tracked points often move coherently, allowing a spatial vector-quantized autoencoder to compress a dense trajectory field into 64 64 patch codes from a 512 512 -entry vocabulary. A 28 28 M transformer predicts these codes from UMT5 [ 4 ] text embeddings. Zero-gated cross-attention adapters then condition the frozen Wan 2.2 DiT through forward hooks, inspired by zero-initialized control pathways [ 33 , 17 ] . Removing the adapters exactly recovers the original model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们学习一种紧凑的运动词汇表，以连接语言与一个冻结的图生视频生成器。 相邻的跟踪点往往连贯地移动，这使得空间向量量化自编码器能够将稠密的轨迹场压缩为来自 512 512 词条词汇表的 64 64 图块编码。 一个 28 28 M 的 transformer 从 UMT5 [ 4 ] 文本嵌入预测这些编码。 随后，零门控交叉注意力适配器通过前向钩子对冻结的 Wan 2.2 DiT 进行条件化，其灵感来自零初始化控制通路 [ 33 , 17 ] 。 移除适配器后即可完全恢复原始模型。

paragraphs.en: A language-predicted discrete motion prior. Motion-code classification enables directional and speed control without user-supplied tracks, drags, or flow. The predictor uses text and a fixed patch grid, rather than image features; object-specific binding is not established by our evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 一种由语言预测的离散运动先验。 运动码分类无需用户提供轨迹、拖拽或光流，即可实现方向和速度控制。 该预测器使用文本和固定的图块网格，而非图像特征；我们的评估并未建立对象特定的绑定。

paragraphs.en: Controlled evaluation of gains and limits. Predicted, across-prompt shuffled, and oracle codes separate the effect of prompt-matched motion content from an uninformative conditioning signal. Continuous trajectory baselines, human judgments, and compound-motion diagnostics complement the main comparison. These tests support directional control but do not isolate spatial grounding or the full source of the oracle gap.
paragraphs.zh: 对增益与局限的受控评估。 预测编码、跨提示打乱编码与真值编码将提示匹配的运动内容的效果与无信息量的条件信号区分开来。 连续轨迹基线、人类评判与复合运动诊断对主要比较起到补充作用。 这些测试支持方向控制，但未能分离空间接地问题或真值差距的完整来源。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models have scaled from U-Net latent-diffusion designs [ 21 , 1 ] to diffusion transformers (DiT) [ 19 ] trained at scale. Recent open systems such as CogVideoX [ 30 ] and Wan 2.2 [ 25 , 22 ] produce high-resolution, temporally consistent clips and are increasingly trained with flow-matching objectives [ 15 , 16 ] . Wan 2.2 in particular is a strong, openly available backbone: a 3 3 D DiT with a spatiotemporal VAE and a UMT5 [ 4 ] text encoder, usable in text-to-video or image-to-video mode. These models excel at semantic faithfulness but expose only the prompt, and optionally a starting frame, as control surfaces, neither of which determines scene motion. ViMoLa treats one such model, in image-to-video mode, as a frozen backbone and adds motion controllability around it.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型已经从 U-Net 潜空间扩散设计 [ 21 , 1 ] 发展到大规模训练的扩散 Transformer（DiT）[ 19 ]。 近期的开源系统，如 CogVideoX [ 30 ] 和 Wan 2.2 [ 25 , 22 ]，能够生成高分辨率、时间上连贯的视频片段，并且越来越多地采用流匹配目标进行训练 [ 15 , 16 ]。 尤其是 Wan 2.2，它是一个强大的、公开可用的骨干模型：一个带有时空 VAE 和 UMT5 [ 4 ] 文本编码器的 3 3 D DiT，可用于文本生成视频或图像生成视频模式。 这些模型在语义忠实度方面表现出色，但仅提供提示词，以及可选的起始帧，作为控制接口，而这两者都不能决定场景的运动。 ViMoLa 将这样一个处于图像生成视频模式的模型视为冻结的骨干模型，并围绕它增加运动可控性。

paragraphs.en: A large body of work makes video generation controllable by conditioning on an explicit motion signal. MotionCtrl [ 27 ] disentangles camera and object motion and injects both into a latent video diffusion model; DragNUWA [ 32 ] and DragAnything [ 28 ] convert user-drawn drags or entity trajectories into spatial conditioning; SparseCtrl [ 8 ] and CameraCtrl [ 10 ] add sparse structural or camera controls; and Trajectory Attention [ 29 ] , SG-I2V [ 18 ] , and MagicMotion [ 14 ] steer motion through attention or dense-to-sparse trajectory guidance. Closest in spirit, Tora [ 34 ] encodes trajectories into spacetime motion patches and fuses them into a DiT, and Motion Prompting [ 6 ] conditions on dense point tracks as a general motion interface.

paragraphs.en: Two distinctions separate ViMoLa from this family. (i) Conditioning modality. All of the above require an explicit motion input at inference, such as a trajectory, a drag, or a dense track field, whereas ViMoLa requires no such motion signal and predicts the motion from a text prompt via a dedicated text-to-motion stage. This makes the systems complementary: a method like Tora or Motion Prompting could in principle consume the tracks our tokenizer decodes, but neither offers a language-to-motion pathway. (ii) Backbone treatment. Many controllers add trainable branches to, or fine-tune, the base U-Net or DiT. ViMoLa keeps the backbone entirely frozen and attaches non-invasive adapters via forward hooks, preserving the pretrained prior and remaining portable across backbones. Since these methods require ground-truth motion at inference, the fair text-only comparison is a text-to-trajectory front-end feeding a trajectory-conditioned generator, which we build and evaluate in Sec. 4 .

paragraphs.en: Adapters add new capabilities to a frozen generator at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning. ControlNet [ 33 ] clones encoder blocks and gates them with zero-initialized convolutions so that training begins from the unmodified model; T2I-Adapter [ 17 ] learns lightweight structural adapters; and IP-Adapter [ 31 ] introduces decoupled cross-attention for image prompts. In the video setting, AnimateDiff [ 9 ] inserts trainable temporal motion modules into a frozen image model and adapts to specific motions with LoRA [ 11 ] . ViMoLa adopts the zero-gated philosophy of ControlNet but differs in mechanism and modality: it adds a parallel cross-attention pathway, rather than a cloned branch or residual convolution, whose key/value memory is a sequence of discrete motion tokens, and it attaches through forward hooks so the base code is never modified.

paragraphs.en: Vector quantization [ 24 ] learns a discrete codebook bottleneck and has become a standard tool for compact, generative-friendly representations; VQGAN [ 5 ] extends it to spatially discrete image tokens that downstream models can predict autoregressively. ViMoLa applies this idea to a new modality: dense spatiotemporal motion fields. Rather than tokenizing pixels, SpatialMotionVQVAE tokenizes per-patch velocity, summarizing each patch’s motion over the clip as a single code. The resulting vocabulary is what lets a small transformer predict motion from text by classification, mirroring how discrete image tokens enable language-style modeling of appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 向量量化 [ 24 ] 学习一个离散码本瓶颈，已成为紧凑且利于生成的表示的标准工具；VQGAN [ 5 ] 将其扩展为空间上离散的图像词元，供下游模型以自回归方式预测。 ViMoLa 将这一思想应用于一种新的模态：稠密的时空运动场。 SpatialMotionVQVAE 并不对像素进行词元化，而是对每个图块的速度进行词元化，将每个图块在整个片段上的运动概括为单一编码。 由此得到的词表使得一个小型 transformer 能够通过分类的方式从文本预测运动，这与离散图像词元实现外观的语言式建模的方式如出一辙。

paragraphs.en: ViMoLa factorizes language-guided motion control into three components trained in sequence on top of a frozen Wan 2.2 backbone ( Fig. 2 ). A spatial motion tokenizer (SpatialMotionVQVAE, Sec. 3.2 ) learns a discrete vocabulary of motion by compressing dense point-trajectory fields into 64 64 codebook tokens. A TextToMotionTransformer ( Sec. 3.3 ) learns to predict those tokens from natural language. A WanMotionAdapter ( Sec. 3.4 ) injects the resulting motion prior into every block of the frozen DiT. Training proceeds in four stages: SpatialMotionVQVAE on trajectory data; cached UMT5 text embeddings; TextToMotionTransformer against frozen tokenizer targets; and the adapters under a flow-matching objective on pre-encoded VAE latents. Stages decouple cleanly, so each component can be developed and debugged independently.
paragraphs.zh: ViMoLa 将语言引导的运动控制分解为三个组件，在冻结的 Wan 2.2 主干之上依次训练（图 2）。 空间运动分词器（SpatialMotionVQVAE，第 3.2 节）通过将稠密的点轨迹场压缩为 64×64 的码本 token，学习一个离散的运动词表。 TextToMotionTransformer（第 3.3 节）学习从自然语言预测这些 token。 WanMotionAdapter（第 3.4 节）将所得的运动先验注入冻结 DiT 的每一个块中。 训练分四个阶段进行：在轨迹数据上训练 SpatialMotionVQVAE；缓存的 UMT5 文本嵌入；以冻结分词器的目标训练 TextToMotionTransformer；以及在预编码的 VAE 潜变量上以流匹配目标训练适配器。 各阶段解耦清晰，因此每个组件都可以独立开发和调试。

paragraphs.en: The adapter must add motion controllability to Wan 2.2 without disturbing the pretrained prior, cheaply and reversibly. Three principles follow. (i) Zero-gated initialization: the adapter contributes exactly zero at the start of training, so the backbone generates as if unconditioned and the motion pathway is admitted only as it earns gradient. (ii) Non-invasive injection: adapters attach through forward hooks, so no line of the backbone is edited and the mechanism transfers to other DiT implementations. (iii) Parallel cross-attention: conditioning is added alongside , not in place of, the block’s computation, leaving the original flow intact.
paragraphs.zh: 该适配器必须在不干扰预训练先验的前提下，为 Wan 2.2 增加运动可控性，且做到低成本、可逆。由此得出三条原则。 （i）零门控初始化：适配器在训练开始时的输出严格为零，因此主干网络的生成如同无条件生成一般，运动通路只有在其获得梯度后才被引入。 （ii）非侵入式注入：适配器通过前向钩子进行挂载，因此无需修改主干网络的任何一行代码，该机制也可迁移到其他 DiT 实现中。 （iii）并行交叉注意力：条件信息是叠加在模块原有计算之上的，而非取而代之，从而保持原有的数据流完整无损。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the three claims of the paper: that ViMoLa (i) achieves text-driven motion control without explicit motion input; (ii) largely maintains the measured generative quality of the frozen backbone; and (iii) does so with limited additional forward compute and no backbone updates . paragraphs.en: We train on ∼ 462 \sim\!462 K real-world videos pooled from Something-Something v2 (SSV2) [ 7 ] and Kinetics-400 (K400) [ 13 ] . SSV2 contributes hand-object interactions with template captions ( e.g . , “pushing [something] from left to right”), which give clean, unambiguous motion supervision; K400 contributes diverse action categories with broader scene motion. For every clip we extract a dense motion field with CoTracker3 [ 12 ] offline: a 32 × 32 32{\times}32 grid of 1024 1024 points tracked over 49 49 frames, stored as velocities and an initial position and normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] 2 [-1,1]^{2} . We hold out 10 % 10\% of the data by action class rather than by video, so evaluation measures generalization to unseen motion descriptions rather than memorization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在约 462 \sim\!462 K 段来自 Something-Something v2（SSV2）[7] 和 Kinetics-400（K400）[13] 的真实世界视频上进行训练。 SSV2 提供带有模板字幕（例如“将 [某物] 从左向右推动”）的手-物体交互，提供干净、无歧义的运动监督；K400 则提供更丰富的动作类别和更宽泛的场景运动。 对于每个片段，我们使用 CoTracker3 [12] 离线提取稠密运动场：在 49 49 帧上跟踪 32 × 32 32{\times}32 网格中的 1024 1024 个点，以速度和一个初始位置的形式存储，并归一化到 [ − 1 , 1 ] 2 [-1,1]^{2} 。 我们按动作类别而非按视频划分出 10 % 10\% 的数据作为留出集，因此评估衡量的是对未见运动描述的泛化能力，而非记忆能力。

paragraphs.en: Motion control is easy to overstate with a metric that drifts between tables, so we fix one protocol and hold it everywhere. Directional accuracy (DA) re-extracts flow from a generated clip, takes the foreground as the top quartile of flow magnitude, reduces its dominant direction to one of four bins, and compares it against the direction named by the caption template. Bin count, foreground mask, label source, and chance are identical in every table, chance is 0.250 0.250 , and we print it in each caption. DA uses a fixed 300 300 -clip subset for the main comparison, ladder, and strength sweep; complex-motion splits have separate sizes reported in the supplementary material. Quality metrics and the main-table trajectory error use the full 5,000 5{,}000 -clip held-out sets. We report 95 % 95\% Wilson intervals, score a single configuration fixed before evaluation, and measure quality at the same s s as control.
paragraphs.zh: 运动控制很容易因指标在各个表格间漂移而被夸大，因此我们固定一套协议，并在所有地方保持一致。 方向准确率（DA）从生成的视频片段中重新提取光流，将光流幅值前四分位作为前景，把其主导方向归为四个方向桶之一，并与字幕模板所指明的方向进行比较。 方向桶数量、前景掩码、标签来源和随机水平在每个表格中都完全相同，随机水平为 0.250，我们在每个图注中都予以标注。 DA 在主要对比、阶梯实验和强度扫描中使用固定的 300 个视频片段子集；复杂运动划分的独立规模在补充材料中报告。 质量指标和主表的轨迹误差使用完整的 5,000 个视频片段的留出集。 我们报告 95% 的 Wilson 区间，对评估前固定的单一配置进行打分，并在与控制相同的 s 下测量质量。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two families end-to-end. The first takes, like ViMoLa, no explicit motion input: the frozen Wan 2.2 [ 22 ] backbone with no adapter, run image-to-video, isolating the adapter’s contribution; AnimateDiff+MotionLoRA [ 9 , 11 ] , run from a prompt alone; and CogVideoX [ 30 ] , image-to-video, as a strong open reference. The second is the natural alternative to our discrete design: predict a continuous trajectory field from the caption and hand it to a generator that consumes trajectories. We build both halves, feeding a continuous regressor into SG-I2V [ 18 ] and, separately, into our own adapter, so the discrete bottleneck is compared against a continuous one under identical text-only conditions. Controllers requiring ground-truth motion at inference [ 27 , 28 , 34 ] solve a different problem ( Sec. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对两个家族进行端到端评估。 第一个家族与 ViMoLa 一样不接收显式运动输入：不带适配器的冻结 Wan 2.2 [22] 主干，以图生视频方式运行，用于隔离适配器的贡献；仅从提示词运行的 AnimateDiff+MotionLoRA [9, 11]；以及作为强开源参考的图生视频模型 CogVideoX [30]。 第二个是我们离散设计的自然替代方案：从字幕预测连续轨迹场，并将其交给一个消费轨迹的生成器。 我们构建了这两种方案，将一个连续回归器接入 SG-I2V [18]，另外再接入我们自己的适配器，从而在相同的纯文本条件下将离散瓶颈与连续瓶颈进行比较。 在推理时需要真实运动标注的控制器 [27, 28, 34] 解决的是另一个问题（见第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The adapter’s attention is invariant to the order of its motion-memory tokens; a spatial tokenizer alone therefore does not establish spatial grounding in generation. TextToMotionTransformer also lacks image features, so counterfactual tests that relocate objects or introduce competing objects are needed to establish named-object control. The across-prompt shuffle tests content matching, and the continuous regressor tests one representation alternative; neither replaces within-prompt spatial tests or a matched text-only adapter baseline.

paragraphs.en: AnimateDiff + MotionLoRA suffers from a compounded failure: because it receives no conditioning frame, it first loses visual and semantic fidelity to the scene ( e.g . , wrong objects, backgrounds, or identities), and then also fails to reproduce the described motion pattern. The MotionLoRA prior biases clips toward generic camera or body motions from its training distribution, further decoupling the output from the action-specific trajectory implied by the text. As a result, AnimateDiff scores poorly on both CLIP alignment and trajectory-based metrics in our quantitative evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: AnimateDiff + MotionLoRA 存在复合式失败：由于它没有接收到任何条件帧，首先会丢失对场景的视觉与语义保真度（例如错误的对象、背景或身份），随后也无法复现所描述的运动模式。 MotionLoRA 的先验会使生成的片段偏向其训练分布中的通用相机或人体运动，进一步使输出与文本所隐含的动作特定轨迹脱钩。 因此，在我们的定量评估中，AnimateDiff 在 CLIP 对齐度和基于轨迹的指标上得分都很低。

paragraphs.en: Every DA number in the paper is computed identically. We re-extract dense optical flow from the generated clip, define the foreground as the points whose flow magnitude falls in the top quartile, average the foreground flow over the clip to obtain a single dominant direction, and quantize that direction into one of four bins (left, right, up, down). The prediction is scored against the direction named by the caption template , never against anything read off the generated clip, so the label source is independent of the model under test. With four equiprobable bins, chance is 0.250 0.250 ; we print this value in every caption that reports DA so that no accuracy figure has to be interpreted in isolation. Intervals on DA are 95 % 95\% Wilson intervals for a binomial proportion, and comparisons between two DA values use a two-proportion z z -test.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中每个 DA 数值的计算方式完全相同。 我们从生成的视频片段中重新提取稠密光流，将光流幅度处于前四分之一的点定义为前景，将整个片段的前景光流取平均以获得单一的主导方向，并将该方向量化为四个区间之一（左、右、上、下）。 预测结果只与字幕模板所指定的方向进行对比打分，绝不与从生成片段中读取的任何内容对比，因此标签来源与被测模型相互独立。 四个等概率区间的随机水平为 0.250；我们在每条报告 DA 的字幕中都印出该数值，使得任何准确率数字都无需被孤立解读。 DA 的置信区间是针对二项比例的 95% Wilson 区间，两个 DA 值之间的比较则使用双比例 z 检验。

paragraphs.en: Seven raters each judged 150 150 clip pairs, giving 1,050 1{,}050 judgments in total. Each pair contains one clip from ViMoLa and one from the frozen Wan 2.2 backbone, generated from the same prompt, the same conditioning frame, and the same random seed, so that the two clips differ only in whether the adapter was attached. Presentation order within each pair was randomized, and raters were not told which system produced which clip or that one of them was the unmodified baseline. For each pair a rater answered three independent questions: which clip moves in the direction the caption describes, which clip moves at the speed the caption implies, and which clip looks better overall. Ties were not permitted on the first two questions and were split evenly on the third.
paragraphs.zh: 七位评分者各自对150 150个片段对进行了评判，共产生1,050 1{,}050条评判。 每个片段对包含一个来自ViMoLa的片段和一个来自冻结的Wan 2.2骨干网络的片段，二者由相同的提示词、相同的条件帧和相同的随机种子生成，因此两个片段之间唯一的区别在于是否接入了适配器。 每个片段对内部的呈现顺序是随机化的，且评分者未被告知哪个片段由哪个系统生成，也不知道其中一个是未经修改的基线。 对于每个片段对，评分者需要回答三个独立的问题：哪个片段朝着字幕所描述的方向运动、哪个片段以字幕所暗示的速度运动，以及哪个片段整体上看起来更好。 前两个问题不允许平局，第三个问题的平局则各计一半。

sents.zh: 七位评分者各自对150 150个片段对进行了评判，共产生1,050 1{,}050条评判。

sents.en: Each pair contains one clip from ViMoLa and one from the frozen Wan 2.2 backbone, generated from the same prompt, the same conditioning frame, and the same random seed, so that the two clips differ only in whether the adapter was attached.
sents.zh: 每个片段对包含一个来自ViMoLa的片段和一个来自冻结的Wan 2.2骨干网络的片段，二者由相同的提示词、相同的条件帧和相同的随机种子生成，因此两个片段之间唯一的区别在于是否接入了适配器。

sents.en: Presentation order within each pair was randomized, and raters were not told which system produced which clip or that one of them was the unmodified baseline.
sents.zh: 每个片段对内部的呈现顺序是随机化的，且评分者未被告知哪个片段由哪个系统生成，也不知道其中一个是未经修改的基线。

sents.en: For each pair a rater answered three independent questions: which clip moves in the direction the caption describes, which clip moves at the speed the caption implies, and which clip looks better overall.
sents.zh: 对于每个片段对，评分者需要回答三个独立的问题：哪个片段朝着字幕所描述的方向运动、哪个片段以字幕所暗示的速度运动，以及哪个片段整体上看起来更好。

sents.en: Ties were not permitted on the first two questions and were split evenly on the third.
sents.zh: 前两个问题不允许平局，第三个问题的平局则各计一半。

paragraphs.en: The failures we observe cluster into three groups, all of which the quantitative results anticipate. Compound prompts naming two successive motions are usually realized as the first motion only, which is the behavior a single code per patch predicts and which Tab. Free-form prompts that do not name a direction produce a plausible but arbitrary one, since the text-to-motion stage represents the ambiguity as a distribution over codes but must commit to a single code at inference.
